records.title: Evaluating a self-manageable architecture for industrial automation systems
records.rationale: 原摘要描述多智能体与IEC 61499实现工业输送系统的自主配置；需方法区分具备推理/决策的智能体与仅消息通信的软件架构，避免将一般工业软件设计直接视为AI4S。

records.title: Semantic models and knowledge graphs as manufacturing system reconfiguration enablers
records.rationale: 原摘要用语义模型/知识图谱匹配制造能力并推荐重配置方案；需核实推理机制及对物理制造系统研究的直接贡献，区分通用资产/资源业务配置。

records.title: Segmentation-based closed-loop layer height control for enhancing stability and dimensional accuracy in wire-based laser metal deposition
records.rationale: 激光线扫描器逐层测量，分段控制器调节送丝速度以控制LMD层高；摘要未显示学习、推理或其他实质AI。

records.title: Adaptive automation: Status of research and future challenges
records.rationale: 自适应自动化综述涉及功能分配、自动化等级及人机界面，但原摘要未明确具体AI方法；需正文确认AI在制造研究中的实质作用。 正常Chrome正式论文页返回内容提供错误CPE00002，待负责人提供原摘要/方法原文。

records.title: Towards industry 5.0 through metaverse
records.rationale: 框架整合数字孪生、VR和工业物联网并比较真实/虚拟装配与操作员培训表现；原摘要未显示实质AI研究贡献。

records.title: A methodology for information modelling and analysis of manufacturing processes for digital twins
records.rationale: 用IDEF0、Petri网和经验/理论/实验分析构建数字孪生信息实体模型；原摘要未显示实质AI方法。

records.title: Computer-controlled 3D freeform surface weaving
records.rationale: 贡献为三维自由曲面编织机、短行成形工艺与W-code计算转换；原摘要未显示实质AI。

records.title: ACWGAN-GP for milling tool breakage monitoring with imbalanced data
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。辅助分类Wasserstein GAN以梯度惩罚生成铣削刀具故障样本，用统计质量筛选器处理不平衡，并以五轴CNC面铣实验验证断裂监测；AI直接参与刀具状态工程研究。

records.title: Research on multi-signal milling tool wear prediction method based on GAF-ResNext
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。将铣削力与振动信号经小波去噪、GAF编码后输入ResNext，学习信号与刀具磨损关系，并以铣削实验数据训练和测试。

records.title: BN-LSTM-based energy consumption modeling approach for an industrial robot manipulator
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。BN-LSTM预测工业机械臂功率；跨UR3e/UR10e迁移并在Yaskawa抛光动作数据验证，直接研究机器人物理能耗。

records.title: Task incremental learning-driven Digital-Twin predictive modeling for customized metal forming product manufacturing process
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。以预训练Temporal Fusion Transformer及任务增量微调建立金属成形数字孪生预测模型，在定制管弯曲平台验证截面变形预测。

records.title: AAGNet: A graph neural network towards multi-task machining feature recognition
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。AAGNet图神经网络在B-Rep几何邻接图上进行加工特征语义/实例/底面分割，并发布MFInstSeg与对比实验，直接服务计算机辅助工艺规划。

records.title: Manipulator joint fault localization for intelligent flexible manufacturing based on reinforcement learning and robot dynamics
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。强化学习学习不同工况的检测参数调节经验，结合机器人动力学进行机械臂故障检测及关节故障定位，包含仿真与真实工业操作验证。

records.title: Fusing LSTM neural network and expanded disturbance Kalman filter for estimating external disturbing forces of ball screw drives
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。以自激实验训练LSTM理想动力学模型，并与扰动动力学及扩展扰动Kalman滤波结合估计滚珠丝杠外部扰动力，在仿真和真实系统验证。

records.title: Privacy-preserving federated transfer learning for defect identification from highly imbalanced image data in additive manufacturing
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。FTLAM以联邦学习、客户端迁移及多损失优化解决增材制造粉末铺展缺陷样本稀少、不平衡和域偏移，在LPBF图像数据上验证缺陷识别。

records.title: Hybrid CNN-LSTM model driven image segmentation and roughness prediction for tool condition assessment with heterogeneous data
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。剪枝UNet3+并结合注意力分割刀具磨损区，再以CNN-LSTM处理异构数据预测加工表面粗糙度，经实际切削实验验证。

records.title: AEGLR-Net: Attention enhanced global–local refined network for accurate detection of car body surface defects
records.rationale: 初筛漏筛补录。AEGLR-Net以Transformer-CNN骨干、跨维注意力及特征金字塔融合检测复杂背景车身表面缺陷，并报告检测精度与速度对比。
